query: INSERT INTO device (org_id, id, name, os, arch, app_version, first_seen_at, last_seen_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $7) ON CONFLICT (org_id, id) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, os = EXCLUDED.os, arch = EXCLUDED.arch, app_version = EXCLUDED.app_version, last_seen_at = EXCLUDED.last_seen_at
